# Wharf 0.8.0 research

## Scope

Session 8 establishes the Copilot CLI adapter and secret boundary. It must
record requested and effective versions, normalize frontier effort, restrict
endpoints, and construct a headless invocation without placing credential
values in arguments, environment configuration, or logs.

## Decisions

- Keep the adapter behind `Wharf.Copilot` interfaces so future adapters do not
  leak into the execution layer.
- Require an exact three-part requested/effective CLI version match.
- Support environment-variable, file, and stdin credential sources; only
  source metadata is retained.
- Permit only HTTPS endpoints whose hosts are explicitly allowlisted.
- Expose a redacted command made solely from non-secret invocation arguments.

## Deferred

Installing the CLI, executing tasks, container isolation, trajectory capture,
and patch retention remain Session 9 work.
